name: Berlinki hot dogs with French fries
title: Hot dogs and fries

steps.text: French fries in the oven (about 20 minutes, check the bag).
Turn the fries. Put a pan of water on to boil for the hot dogs.
Water boiling: Berlinki hot dogs in, 5 minutes. Warm the buns in the oven for the last 2 minutes if you like.
Drain the hot dogs, fries out.
Serve in buns with ketchup, mustard, crispy onions.
